name: CLIProxyAPI
author: router-for-me
description: CLIProxyAPI turns OAuth logins of Codex (ChatGPT), Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Kimi and other CLI subscriptions into OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API endpoints, with multi-account round-robin, a web management panel and usage statistics. Use it as an upstream provider in LiteLLM through its OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint.

form_fields.label: Management password
form_fields.hint: Password for the web management panel and management API. Avoid the $ character.

form_fields.label: Initial client API key material
form_fields.hint: Generated automatically; the initial client key is sk-cpa- followed by this value. It is written to config.yaml on first start only — manage keys in the panel afterwards.
